title: FRANK screen and route contract
description: FRANK-§3.8. A machine-readable contract for every user-facing screen. A route absent from the registry cannot ship. Duplicate paths, undeclared commands, missing authorization, missing state coverage, inaccessible primary actions, and pack route collisions fail CI. URLs contain only opaque identifiers, never secrets or sensitive labels.

id.description: Unique screen identifier in dot-separated form.

path.description: FRANK-§3.8. URL path for this screen. Must contain only opaque identifiers, never secrets or sensitive labels. Use route parameters like :id for opaque resource identifiers only.

navigation.description: Navigation placement: primary (top-level), contextual (within object), or detail (specific record view).

roles.description: FRANK-§3.8 and §2.2. Array of authorized roles. Missing authorization fails CI.

compartments.description: Array of data compartment identifiers this screen respects (project, room, cell scope, etc). Empty array means no compartment filtering.

objects.description: FRANK-§3.8. Array of primary object types shown on this screen. Missing state coverage for an object fails CI.

query_schema.description: Schema identifier for the query parameters accepted by this screen.

commands.description: FRANK-§3.8. Array of command identifiers that may be invoked from this screen. Undeclared commands fail CI.

event_parts.description: Array of event type patterns that trigger live updates on this screen.

states.description: FRANK-§3.7 and §3.8. Array of UI states this screen must implement: loading, empty, partial, stale, offline, denied, degraded, error, recovery, success. Missing state coverage fails CI.

offline.description: FRANK-§3.7. Offline handling strategy: read-cached (serve stale data), sync-on-connect (queue updates), or none (disable offline).

capabilities.description: FRANK-§3.7. Array of platform capabilities required: camera, microphone, geolocation, filesystem, native-bridge, push, share-target.

deep_links.description: Array of platforms supporting deep links to this screen: web, pwa, tauri.

acceptance_journeys.description: FRANK-§3.7. Array of versioned acceptance test journeys that exercise this screen.
